case: PostgreSQL custom-enum CSV import supports schema, table, and type identifiers with spaces and embedded quotes under a same-named shadow search_path
contract: A CSV row imports into a target whose schema, table, and enum type names contain spaces and embedded double quotes.
The role search_path leads with a same-named shadow schema and enum that does not contain the target value.
The generated insert plan uses a correctly escaped, schema-qualified enum cast.
The imported row has the target native enum type; existing target rows and the shadow row remain unchanged.
